title: Hana Likes Food
gist_ar: واحد بيتكلم عن أخته هنا وحبها للأكل والطبيخ.

before_listening.en: Someone talks about his sister. Listen for what she WANTS.
before_listening.ar: حد بيتكلم عن أخته. ركّز على هي عايزة إيه.

segments.speaker: Youssef
segments.text: My sister Hana likes food very much. She eats rice and chicken every day. She does not eat fish. She drinks coffee in the morning and tea in the evening. She cooks with my mother on Friday. They make some soup and some bread. Hana wants a big kitchen, but our kitchen is small. She says, one day I have a restaurant. I think she can do it.

options: A big kitchen and one day a restaurant

questions.q: When does she cook with her mother?
